summary: Wrote 19 DQ rules for base.conformed_facts covering all 6 categories from spec section 7 plus additional edge cases from EDA

rules_written.rationale_summary: Grain uniqueness at (cik, business_term_id, fiscal_year, fiscal_period). EDA: 28,849 unique grains, 0 duplicates.
conformed_id (SHA-256 hash of grain) uniqueness. Structural — catches hash or write bugs.
source_fact_id FK to base.financial_facts. Critical for lineage traceability.
20 distinct CIKs. EDA: all 20 companies present.
25 distinct business_term_ids. EDA: all 25 BTs present.
No NULLs in any required column (22 of 25 columns are required per spec).
val matches source financial_facts value. P1 not P0 due to floating-point edge cases.
competing_fact_count >= 1. Structural — every fact competes at minimum with itself.
selection_reason enum validation. Only 3 valid values per spec.
Cross-field: sole_candidate iff competing_fact_count = 1. EDA cross-field analysis item 1.
Unit-to-BT consistency: per-share terms get USD/shares, others get USD. EDA cross-field analysis item 2.
Per-company minimum 15 BTs. EDA: minimum is 17 (JPMorgan, Berkshire). Buffer of 2.
fiscal_period enum: FY, Q1, Q2, Q3 only.
Fiscal year range: min <= 2010, max >= 2025. EDA: observed 2006-2026.
promoted_at within 7 days. Batch pipeline recency check per governance-reviewer advisory.
selection_reason distribution monitoring: sole 40-65%, primary 30-55%, fallback <= 10%. EDA: 51/47/2%.
No superseded facts in output. Supersession filter removes 49.3% of source; leakage = broken filter.

rules_considered_not_written.reason: EDA shows 21.8% negative values are expected (losses, outflows, per-share losses). Not a data quality issue.
EDA shows 2.01% zero values are legitimate. Would be P3 at best. Not worth a rule — no actionable threshold.
EDA shows only 480 grains for BT-035 (Gross Profit) — structural, not a DQ issue. Many companies don't report GrossProfit concept.
EDA shows 17.1% Q1 vs ~29% Q2/Q3 — expected from XBRL quarterly filing patterns, not a DQ issue.
